newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Meditrust started as a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Meditrust started as a buy.

text.p: Salomon Brothers said it initiated coverage of Meditrust with a buy rating.
-- said believes the long-term trends of the nursing home and assisted living industries are positive.
-- said expects the company's long-term growth rate to accelerate over time from about four percent annually to eight percent or more.

-- expects funds from operation per share to be $3.04 in 1997 and $3.11 for 1998 and $3.49 for 1999. Said those estimates include the proposed Santa Anita merger. Said the estimates are on a pre-split basis.
-- said the 12-month price target is $43.50 a share.
